sequence: start, intermediate, endpoint, endpoint hold, intermediate return, start return

frames.label: Supported start
frames.cue: Rest upper arms on pad; keep elbows soft.

frames.label: Curl
frames.cue: Curl the bar without lifting your upper arms.

frames.label: Top curl
frames.cue: Bring the bar up with shoulders still.

frames.label: Brief hold
frames.cue: Hold briefly without shrugging or bending wrists.

frames.label: Controlled lower
frames.cue: Lower slowly with upper arms against the pad.

frames.label: Return
frames.cue: Stop short of locking your elbows.
